parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The IP address or domain name.

parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client must generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The state of the address. Valid values:

- enable: The address is enabled.

- disable: The address is disabled.

parameters.name: HealthStatus
parameters.description:
The health status of the address. Valid values:

- ok: All health check tasks that are associated with the address are normal.

- ok\_alert: Some health check tasks that are associated with the address are abnormal, but the address is still considered normal.

- ok\_no\_monitor: No health check template is associated with the address.

- exceptional: Some or all health check tasks that are associated with the address are abnormal, and the address is considered abnormal.

parameters.name: MonitorTemplateId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the health check template.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the address. Valid values:

- IPv4

- IPv6

- domain
